company.name: Sendoso
company.shortDescription: Sendoso helps companies connect and drive revenue with personalized gifts, eGifts, virtual experiences, and more.
company.description: Sendoso is a sending platform that helps companies stand out by giving them new ways to engage with customers throughout the buyer’s journey. By integrating digital and physical sending strategies, companies can increase the effectiveness of their existing go-to-market programs and improve their relationships with customers. Trusted by over 500 companies, Sendoso is an essential part of successful demand generation, account-based, and customer experience programs. Founded in 2016, Sendoso is backed by $54M in venture funding and has a global footprint, with a presence in North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Learn more at sendoso.com.

aiResearchSummary.text: Sendoso is researching and developing a gift sending platform for business contacts, as described in the title and abstract detailing a method for selecting recipients from a contact database, scheduling package deliveries, and providing scannable codes for tracking or interaction. This work focuses on streamlining the process of sending personalized gifts to business contacts, supporting the company's emphasis on personalized gifting and engagement solutions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $100,000,000, or 65.49% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,197,722 to $640,000,000, a 69.58x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
